source.caution:
- 과량 섭취하지 않도록 주의할 것

Made by 우리바이오(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 0.44mg of Vitamin B1, 40mg of Vitamin C, 3μg of Vitamin D, 8.5mg of Zinc, 2.3mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 0.44mg Vitamin B1, 40mg Vitamin C, 3μg Vitamin D, 8.5mg Zinc, 2.3mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 우리바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Vitamin B1 labelled (0.44mg / 900mg), 80~180%
Vitamin C labelled (40mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (3μg / 900mg), 80~180%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (2.3mg / 900mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 색택과 향미를 가지며 이미, 이취가 없는 노란색의 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터24개월
Storage 실온보존 및 실온유통

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B1 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Zinc · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
